---
name: Feature request
about: Something swiss should do
labels: enhancement
---

**The problem**
What you are trying to do and why the current build gets in the way.

**The shape you have in mind**
A CLI verb, a panel page, an MCP tool, a config field — whatever it is. Sketches welcome.

**Fit**
swiss is one loopback process with a memory budget (SPEC §product.memory) and a hard non-goals list in the
README (never remote, no self-update, no saving on proc MCPs). If the idea touches one of those,
say how it stays inside the line.
